answer: Proposed: each paid comet-tracking, summit-weather or reef-monitoring key must upload its meter's fresh, key-bound 100 MB random challenge in 10 seconds daily. Independent meters sign key/day, bytes and times; validators deny pay for missing, late, invalid or reused receipts. Meters require full uncompressed traffic. Routers are reusable capital; transit rental recurs; no stake is locked. Colluding meters can fake receipts; spare capacity can make cash cost tiny. With honest meters, ten simultaneous keys still need 1 GB/day of uploads and 800 Mb/s aggregate, even on one host.
